_design: Gary explicitly added log + stump to snow biome for desolate feel. This feature now serves both forest and snow contexts. Forest: post-harvest narrative, harvested grove legacy. Snow: fallen deadwood half-buried in snow. nearFeature gate kept for forest (only near groves). Snow references this without nearFeature gate (open field deadfall).

placement._: nearFeature gate means these appear within ~6 cells of a grove center. Overridden to null in snow_debris.json which is the open-field version.
